theorems.name: Submission.allard_tc_cone_rescaling_invariance
theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (C : Varifold N n (univ : Set (Euclidean N))) (M : Set (Euclidean N)) (θ : Euclidean N → ℝ), IsVarifoldOf C M θ → (∀ x ∈ M, ∃ T : Grassmannian N n, HasTangentPlane C x T (θ x)) → (∀ A : Set (Euclidean N × Grassmannian N n), MeasurableSet A → C.measure A = ∫⁻ x in {x | x ∈ M ∧ ∃ T : Grassmannian N n, HasTangentPlane C x T (θ x) ∧ (x, T) ∈ A}, ENNReal.ofReal (θ x) ∂μHE[n]) → (∀ (s : ℝ) (A : Set (Euclidean N)), 0 < s → C.weight (s • A) = ENNReal.ofReal s ^ n * C.weight A) → ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → rescaledMeasure C 0 s = C.measure
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
